visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a brown sweater speaks directly to the camera in an eye-level selfie-style shot. Behind him, a large white Samoyed dog lies on a wooden chair against a plain white wall with bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a stylized black screen with a central white circle containing the dog's head; text appears indicating the start of a challenge. (3) The man is shown putting a gray patterned bandana around the white dog's neck, using his hands to secure it while the dog pants happily. (4) The dog is filmed from a low angle walking through a cluttered indoor storage area filled with cardboard boxes and electronic equipment, sniffing the environment. (5) A close-up shows the dog's face buried in a box; the man's hand reaches in to pull the dog away. (6) The man looks at a smartphone screen with a shocked expression, then holds up a red and white promotional card for Trend Micro. (7) A sequence of screen recordings shows a mobile app interface with red and green warning icons and various Chinese text menus. (8) The man returns to a selfie-perspective, holding the phone and the promotional card, explaining features with energetic hand gestures. (9) The video concludes with the man smiling and posing with the dog, holding the red card near the camera.
